dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: The prophecy is the biggest crisis Fontaine has faced so far. But I have other things to worry about as well.

dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: And even today some are discussing whether the prophecy was real or not. They just can't see what's really important.

dialogues.speaker: Riqueti
dialogues.text: We can't ignore all our other problems simply because we survived a major crisis. Assuming that life will be easy from now on is... well, it's either optimism or ignorance.
